name: list_jobs
description: List the most recent remote jobs from RemoteOK (a popular, tech-heavy remote-work job board; keyless). Returns the newest postings (id, position, company, location, tags, salary range, date, url) without the long HTML description. Salaries are USD when present (0 = not disclosed).

name: search_jobs
description: Keyword-search current RemoteOK remote-job listings. Matches the query (case-insensitive) against job position, company name, or any tag. Tech-heavy board; keyless. Returns matching postings (id, position, company, location, tags, salary range, date, url). Salaries are USD when present.

query.description: Keyword to match against position, company, or tags (e.g. "javascript", "designer").

name: get_job
description: Get the full RemoteOK job posting for a given job id, including the full HTML description. Use an id returned by list_jobs or search_jobs. Only jobs in the current ~100 most-recent listings are available. Salaries are USD when present.
